Meet Joshua.

I'm a graphic designer first: posters, sports graphics, magazine-style layouts and event collages that make school and sport look as good as they feel.

I design for St. Peter's College and school cricket, then back it up with photo editing, video, audio and code. I'm an Old Peterite and a Higher National Diploma student in Information Technology. I learn new tools fast, check my work twice and finish what I start. Outside the screen I played basketball for five years, trained in judo and competed in throwing events.

What I make

Five crafts that feed each other, led by graphic design. Try the demos.

Graphic design

Posters, sports spotlights, match summary cards, magazine-style features and photo collages. I focus on clear hierarchy, strong typography and colour that carries the mood. This is my Champions graphic for the Jaffna Bulls.

  • Adobe Photoshop
BeforeAfter

Photo editing

Colour grading, contrast and retouching in Photoshop. This is one of my own edits, a night rugby shot. Drag across it to see the raw photo become the final image: cleaner shadows, richer colour and a sharper subject.

  • Adobe Photoshop

Video editing

Cutting and pacing in Premiere Pro, with motion and effects in After Effects. One clean pass from first frame to last.

  • Premiere Pro
  • After Effects

Audio mixing and mastering

Editing and mixing in Cubase: balancing levels, EQ and dynamics so a track stays clear and loud without being harsh. Toggle to see an uneven mix become a tight master.

  • Cubase

Web design

HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with Supabase for data. I built a full student marketplace and I care about motion that feels natural.

Selected designs

My graphic design work: player spotlights, magazine-style features, event collages, posters and match cards for schools, rugby, cricket and music events. Tap any piece to enlarge it.
